questions.nlq: Provide, for each product category, the product that has received the greatest number of complaints, the total number of complaints for that product, the full name of the staff member who handled the most recent complaint for that product, and the email address of the customer who lodged that most recent complaint.

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH complaint_counts AS (
        SELECT
            p.product_id,
            p.product_category_code,
            COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS complaint_count
        FROM Products p
        JOIN Complaints c ON c.product_id = p.product_id
        GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_category_code
    ),
    recent_complaint AS (
        SELECT
            c.product_id,
            c.complaint_id,
            c.staff_id,
            c.customer_id,
            c.date_complaint_raised,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.product_id ORDER BY c.date_complaint_raised DESC) AS rn
        FROM Complaints c
    ),
    recent_per_product AS (
        SELECT
            rc.product_id,
            rc.staff_id,
            rc.customer_id,
            rc.date_complaint_raised
        FROM recent_complaint rc
        WHERE rc.rn = 1
    ),
    category_rank AS (
        SELECT
            cc.product_category_code,
            cc.product_id,
            cc.complaint_count,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.product_category_code ORDER BY cc.complaint_count DESC) AS rn
        FROM complaint_counts cc
    )
SELECT
    cr.product_category_code,
    p.product_name,
    cr.complaint_count,
    s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS staff_full_name,
    cu.email_address AS customer_email
FROM category_rank cr
